description: Ministry of Higher Education and Highways -  Order to amend the Gazette Ex. No. 896/2 of 07.11.1995 by adding Faculty of Technology to the Rajarata University
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of a university's academic structure through a legal order issued under the authority of The Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. While it mentions a Minister's name, the core content is about regulatory changes to the university's faculties and departments, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content fits Type 5 as it constitutes a statutory instrument modifying existing regulations.
